## 7. Checklist

Before requesting a review, make sure:

- [ ] My branch follows the branch naming convention.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the commit convention.
- [ ] My code follows the existing project structure and conventions.
- [ ] I have tested my changes.
- [ ] I have not committed `.env`, credentials, or other sensitive information.
- [ ] I have reviewed my own changes.
- [ ] My PR targets the correct base branch (`main`).
